paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations. Row 1 (Baseline): Significant massive activations and attention sinks emerge after the 6th layer. Row 2 (SDPA Gating): Reduced activations and no attention sinks observed. Row 3 (Value Layer Gating): Similar activations to Row 2 but with residual attention sinks. Rows 4–5 (Reduced Sparsity via cross-head share and NS-sigmoid): Massive activations and attention sinks resemble the baseline.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира промените в максималните стойности на активация за различни компоненти на модела през отделните слоеве, като е озаглавена „Massive Activation of baseline". Оста X е обозначена като „Layer" и използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като „Max Activation Value" и използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до 1600, с етикети през 200 единици (0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, 1400, 1600).

В графиката са представени четири линии. Първата линия, обозначена като „attn_output", е с син цвят и пунктиран стил (тире-точка). Тя остава близо до нулата от слой 0 до приблизително слой 20, след което рязко нараства, достигайки стойност около 600 в района на слой 23. Втората линия, „attn_residual", е с оранжев цвят и точков (dotted) стил. Тя е близо до нулата от слой 0 до около слой 5, след което рязко нараства до приблизително 1400 около слой 6, продължава да се покачва леко до около 1500 в района на слоеве 7–14, задържа се на това ниво до слой 20, а след това рязко спада до стойности около 600 при слой 23. Третата линия, „ffn_output", е с зелен цвят и стил тире-точка. Тя остава близо до нулата от слой 0 до приблизително слой 4, след което рязко скача до около 1400 при слой 5, бързо спада обратно към ниски стойности около 0–50 в района на слоеве 6–12, след това показва рязък скок нагоре до приблизително 500 при слой 13–14, отново спада към ниски стойности до слой 20, и накрая нараства до около 600 при слой 23. Четвъртата линия, „ffn_residual", е с червен цвят и плътен стил. Тя остава близо до нулата от слой 0 до около слой 5, след което рязко нараства до приблизително 1500 при слой 6, задържа се на стабилно ниво между 1500 и 1580 от слой 6 до приблизително слой 20, а след това рязко спада до стойности около 400 при слой 23.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure, titled "Massive Activation of baseline," displays the maximum activation value across layers for four different activation components in a large language model baseline configuration. The x-axis represents "Layer," scaled linearly from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis represents "Max Activation Value," scaled linearly from 0 to 1600, with major tick marks at intervals of 200. Four lines are plotted. The first, "attn_output," is shown as a blue dashed line with no visible markers; it remains near 0 from layer 0 through approximately layer 20, then rises sharply to reach roughly 600 by layer 23. The second, "attn_residual," is depicted as an orange dotted line; it stays near 0 until around layer 5, where it rises steeply to approximately 1400 by layer 6, continues increasing to roughly 1500 around layer 8–9, remains near 1500 through about layer 20, and then drops sharply to approximately 400 by layer 23. The third, "ffn_output," is shown as a green dash-dot line; it remains near 0 from layer 0 to about layer 4, spikes sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, then drops back to near 0 around layer 7, stays near 0 until approximately layer 13, where it spikes again to around 500, drops back toward 0 near layer 15, remains low until around layer 21, and then rises steeply to roughly 600 at layer 23. The fourth, "ffn_residual," is a red solid line; it stays near 0 from layer 0 to around layer 5, rises steeply to approximately 1500 by layer 6, plateaus near 1500–1575 from approximately layer 7 through layer 20, and then drops sharply to around 400 by layer 23.
model_annotations.English:
This plot, titled "Massive Activation of baseline," illustrates the maximum activation values across different transformer layers for four different activation measurement points in a baseline language model configuration. The x-axis represents "Layer," displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Max Activation Value," displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200.

Four lines are shown. The blue dashed line with no visible markers represents "attn_output," which remains near 0 from layer 0 through approximately layer 20, then rises sharply to around 600 by layer 23. The orange dotted line represents "attn_residual," which stays near 0 from layer 0 to around layer 4, then rises steeply to approximately 1400 by layer 6, continues increasing gradually to roughly 1500 around layer 8–9, maintains values near 1500 through layer 20, and then drops sharply to approximately 400–600 by layer 23. The green dash-dot line represents "ffn_output," which remains near 0 from layer 0 to about layer 4, spikes sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, then drops back to near 0 around layer 7, remains low until about layer 13, spikes again to roughly 400–500 around layer 14–15, returns to near 0 by layer 16, and then rises steeply to approximately 600 at layer 23. The red solid line represents "ffn_residual," which stays near 0 from layer 0 through layer 4, rises steeply to approximately 1500 around layer 6, plateaus near 1500–1560 from roughly layer 7 through layer 20, and then drops sharply to approximately 400 by layer 23.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm trägt den Titel „Massive Activation of baseline" und zeigt den maximalen Aktivierungswert über verschiedene Schichten eines Modells für vier unterschiedliche Signalkomponenten. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala und erstreckt sich von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Max Activation Value" beschriftet, ebenfalls linear skaliert, und reicht von 0 bis 1600, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 200. Es werden vier Linien dargestellt: Die Linie „attn_output" ist blau, gestrichelt mit Strichpunkt-Muster und verläuft von Layer 0 bis etwa Layer 20 nahe bei 0, steigt dann ab Layer 21 steil an und erreicht bei Layer 23 einen Wert von etwa 600. Die Linie „attn_residual" ist orange und gepunktet; sie bleibt bis etwa Layer 5 nahe 0, steigt dann steil auf etwa 1400 an, verläuft danach relativ konstant bei etwa 1500 bis Layer 20, wo sie abrupt auf etwa 600 bei Layer 23 abfällt. Die Linie „ffn_output" ist grün mit Strichpunkt-Muster und Dreiecksmarkierungen; sie bleibt bis Layer 4 nahe 0, springt bei Layer 5 steil auf etwa 1400, fällt dann bei Layer 6 wieder auf nahe 0 ab, zeigt bei Layer 13 bis 15 einen erneuten scharfen Anstieg auf etwa 500, fällt danach wieder auf nahe 0 und steigt ab Layer 21 erneut steil auf etwa 600 bei Layer 23 an. Die Linie „ffn_residual" ist rot und durchgezogen; sie verläuft bis Layer 4 nahe 0, steigt bei Layer 5 steil auf etwa 1400 an, erreicht ab Layer 7 ein Plateau bei etwa 1500 bis 1550, das bis Layer 20 anhält, und fällt dann bei Layer 21 bis 23 steil auf etwa 400 ab.
